purpose: Athena's activation metadata for a future read-only shadow window. The product is pinned and separately qualification-evidenced, but no production Athena installation or materialization is claimed here; `bun run pr:athena` remains the repository's only delivery authority. The discovery-scoping mechanism itself is product-owned; this document carries only Athena's activation positions and the guard that enforces them.

product.compositionProfileNote: the fixture profile registers deliveries only in the disposable repositories its install receipt names, so an installation serving repository athena must carry the production profile; the read-only posture comes from this document's shadow installation mode, not from the profile

qualificationFixture.scope: product qualification only; it is not an Athena installation, projection, or delivery

installationPaths.rule: disposable, operator-chosen directories created for the shadow window only
prohibited: the operator's real Claude Code configuration directory
the operator's real Codex configuration directory
any path inside the Athena working tree

projection.owner: the product's Claude Code binding (materialization, digest receipt, per-run consumption marker, teardown)
projection.scopeRule: the projection root may exist only inside a managed delivery worktree; the repository root and every non-managed worktree must not carry one
projection.managedDeliveryWorktreePathShape: the operator creates each managed delivery worktree at .worktrees/managed/<deliveryId> — a sibling path such as .worktrees/managed-<deliveryId> is not a managed delivery worktree and a projection there is a finding
projection.mechanism: model-external and byte-neutral — the binding writes its session settings and the worktree-scoped excludes file into its own directory outside the working tree, points the managed worktree's worktree-scoped git configuration at them, and enables worktree configuration once in the shared repository config; no tracked byte of the vendored discovery layout is moved or edited, and the configuration takes effect in the managed worktree alone
projection.whatIsNotSuppressed: no unqualified or unsupported host is admitted to an M1 delivery lane. The proving Claude Code lane must use the qualified --restricted, empty-setting-sources binding profile, which scopes discovery to the run-pinned projection; the guard treats coexistence with the ambient vendored generation in a managed worktree as a finding

hosts.capability: the qualified delivery lane uses --restricted and binding-composed settings with empty ambient setting sources, so its run-pinned projection is the only admitted discovery source

exclusivityPosition.reason: the sole proving delivery host is Claude Code 2.1.252 under the qualified restricted, empty-setting-sources binding profile; coexistence with ambient vendored discovery in a managed delivery worktree would invalidate that lane rather than remain diagnostic
exclusivityPosition.becomesBlockingAt: this M1 proving-host lane; any later host requires its own qualified admission record
exclusivityPosition.beforeThatGate: no tracked byte of the vendored discovery layout changes

consumptionRecord.requiredSource: the host-neutral projection-consumption observation contract, accepted only when the qualified host reports a completed full Read of the direct receipt-derived canonical workflow path with the matching delivery, fence, host invocation, and projection digest
consumptionRecord.producedBy: Claude Code is the sole qualified producer at this generation. Its model-external PostToolUse Read observation is admitted by the host-neutral contract; unsupported hosts produce no affirmative evidence and remain excluded from M1
consumptionRecord.agentSuppliedClaims: rejected — a delivery carrying one is excluded from the comparison set and the guard reports a finding
consumptionRecord.whatTheGuardChecks: the record's declared source and shape. The guard does not reproduce the host observation, repository binding, or scorer; those remain the harness product and explicit scorer boundaries
consumptionRecord.whatProvenanceRestsOn: the host-neutral observation contract, the Claude-qualified adapter, and the binding-side writer that derives the delivery repository identity and accepts only the real repository's literal .agents/policy/shadow-milestone-gate-record.json single-link target. .agents is an additionally protected path in every checkpoint grant of .agents/policy/repository-policy.json, so no execution grant may write the gate record

vendoredDiscoveryLayout.note: the guard owns the layout's path set and its pinned byte digest; they are not duplicated here so there is one place to change and one place to review

characterization.method: a disposable Athena-identity scratch characterization through the explicit-input scorer loaded from the exact agent-delivery-harness source checkout over Athena's authority artifacts. The current host-owned driver exposes no Athena-identity runtime launcher, so this run establishes only the 0/3 incomplete result and creates no host session, projection, policy compilation, or gate entry. No runtime claim is inferred from this scorer path

result.note: the explicit scorer creates no delivery, projection, host callback, or gate-record mutation

historicalScopeCharacterization.method: a disposable confirmation-fixture shadow install, one projection materialization into a managed worktree, one binding-authored marker record, and one policy compilation; it launched no host runtime and was later reclassified as non-counting diagnostic field data

gateRecordEntry.nonCountingReason: the historical materialization predated the qualified exact-Read admission contract, so it has no qualified host callback and fills no M1 slot

characterization.conclusion: The current exact-pin observation is only an explicit Athena-input scorer result: it is incomplete with zero counted deliveries. The historical scope characterization remains clearly pinned to its own earlier product and cannot establish the current product's runtime, policy compilation, host callback, or M1 readiness. The consolidated generation supplies the host-neutral observation contract, Claude-qualified producer, repository-derived canonical target binding, and frozen first-report scoring semantics, but Athena remains at zero of three until real shadow deliveries produce qualified evidence.
